Iconic Dialogues From ‘The Devil Wears Prada’ and ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’: Best Lines That Still Feel Sharp And Timeless

May 18, 2026, 18:16 IST
Nearly two decades on, The Devil Wears Prada remains one of those rare films people quote without even realising it. Miranda Priestly did not simply speak, she delivered verdicts. Every line still lands just as hard today as it did in 2006. With The Devil Wears Prada 2 now back in theatres, the iconic cast has returned to remind audiences why this story never really left. The sequel brings fresh chaos to the fashion world, and with it, a brand new set of lines already earning their place in pop culture. The original film handed us some of the sharpest dialogue in modern cinema. Miranda made cold authority look effortless and Emily was always right behind her. The sequel wastes no time. Miranda is sharper, Emily is funnier, and the new cast holds its ground with confidence. What makes both films hold up so well is simple. The writing never talked down to its audience. These were not throwaway one-liners. They were character. They told you exactly who Miranda was, who Emily was, and what this world demanded of everyone inside it. The sequel understands that assignment completely. Fashion fades, but a truly great line never does.

OTT Releases This Week (18 May - 24 May 2026): ‘Desi Bling’, ‘System’ And More Movies And Web Shows Releasing On Streaming Platforms

May 18, 2026, 14:07 IST
​The third week of May brings a busy and varied OTT line-up, with platform releases ranging from sharp courtroom drama to glossy reality entertainment and high-stakes thrillers. The mix feels broad enough to suit viewers looking for something serious, something breezy or something with a bit of both. What stands out this week is how different these titles are in tone and texture. Some lean on star power, others on mood and mystery, but each one has enough going for it to make the watchlist feel fuller than usual. Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari’s System arrives on Amazon Prime Video on May 22, 2026, Sonakshi Sinha and Jyotika at the centre of a courtroom story built on privilege, pressure and quiet conflict. Sonakshi plays an ambitious public prosecutor who is chasing a crucial run of wins, while Jyotika brings a sharper, more grounded presence to the case. The film looks set to work as both a legal drama and a character study. Netflix will stream Desi Bling from May 20, 2026 turning the spotlight on Indian expats in Dubai and their polished, high-energy world. With Karan Kundrra and Tejasswi Prakash among the familiar faces, the series promises glamour, personal drama and the kind of social dynamics that reality TV thrives on. It is designed to give viewers plenty of sparkle with the inevitable emotional spillover. Amazon Prime Video brings Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War on May 20,2026 with John Krasinski returning to a dangerous mission after stepping away from active fieldwork. The series brings back the familiar mix of covert operations, betrayal and international danger, with a new conspiracy that forces Ryan to depend on old allies and new instincts. Netflix releases The Boroughs on May 21, 2026 and the show shifts into eerie territory, with Alfred Molina leading the story of a widower who discovers something deeply unsettling in a retirement community. Backed by the Duffer Brothers, the show blends supernatural suspense with an unusual setting, giving the mystery a slower, stranger kind of menace. SonyLIV will stream Madhuvidhu on May 22, and this Malayalam romantic comedy follows a young man whose search for marriage is complicated by family superstition and everyday chaos. Sharafudheen leads the film with Kalyani Panicker, while veteran comedians add the kind of comic timing that gives the story warmth and pace. Netflix releases Ladies First on May 22, bringing Sacha Baron Cohen into a sharply flipped world where gender roles have been completely reversed. The film follows a powerful man who suddenly finds himself in a reality where women hold the reins and men are pushed to the margins. With Rosamund Pike also part of the cast, the film blends satire, social commentary and broad comedy in a way that should make it stand out from the week’s line-up. Lee Cronin’s The Mummy arrives on May 19 and will be available to buy and rent on Prime Video, Apple TV and Google Play. The film takes a familiar horror concept and gives it a more intimate, unsettling edge. The story follows a journalist and his wife as they search for their missing daughter, only to stumble into something far more frightening in the Egyptian desert. Jack Reynor leads the cast, with Laia Costa, May Calamawy and Verónica Falcón adding to the tension. ZEE5 will stream Satrangi: Badle Ka Khel on May 22 with Anshumaan Pushkar stars in this revenge-driven series set in rural Uttar Pradesh, where identity, caste and power shape every move. The show uses performance and secrecy as part of its emotional pull, making the revenge arc feel rooted in a much larger social world. This week’s OTT slate is less about one big title and more about range. The strongest draw is the variety itself, with each project offering a different mood and a different kind of engagement. For viewers, that usually means one thing: there is plenty worth queuing up.

‘Panchayat’ Season 5 OTT Release Date: When Will Jitendra Kumar Return As Sachiv Ji In The Next Chapter Of Phulera?

May 18, 2026, 12:22 IST
Not many web series get five seasons and still have people genuinely excited about what comes next. Panchayat is one of them. With Season 5 officially confirmed on Amazon Prime Video, the wait for another round of Phulera's politics, relationships and everyday drama has begun in earnest. At the heart of it all is Jitendra Kumar's Abhishek Tripathi, a city-bred engineer who landed in a village and never quite managed to leave. His story has resonated with a whole generation of viewers and Season 5 is set to continue from exactly where Season 4 left things, unresolved, emotional and full of potential. The show is confirmed to premiere on Amazon Prime Video in 2026, though an exact date is yet to be announced. The series is written by Chandan Kumar and directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra. Jitendra Kumar returns alongside Neena Gupta, Raghubir Yadav, Sanvikaa, Faisal Malik and Chandan Roy. The new season will see Abhishek navigating life under what the makers describe as new and vengeful leadership in Phulera, even as his MBA dreams remain on the horizon. Lingering threads from Season 4, including the village election result and his relationship with Rinki, are all expected to be addressed. Panchayat has always been about the small moments that feel quietly big, and Season 5 looks no different. With the Phulera gang back together, the wait for 2026 just got a lot more exciting. The show has grown with its audience over the years, and each season has managed to feel more grounded and real than the last. For now, all eyes are on Phulera.

Box Office Collection Update (17 May 2026): How Much Have ‘Pati Patni Aur Woh Do’, ‘Bhooth Bangla’, ‘Raja Shivaji’ And Other Films Collected So Far?

May 18, 2026, 10:59 IST
This weekend at the box office has been an interesting one, with a new release finding its feet while some older films continue to hold their ground. The Hindi film industry has had a packed few weeks, and the numbers from Sunday are a reflection of just how varied the audience's appetite has been. From a fresh romantic comedy generating early buzz to a horror comedy quietly nearing a major milestone, the 17 May box office update tells quite a story on its own. Mudassar Aziz's latest comic caper, starring Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, Rakul Preet Singh and Vamika Gabbi, has shown healthy growth over its opening weekend. The film follows a seemingly settled couple in Prayagraj whose lives are thrown into comic disarray by one fateful decision. Day 3 saw a solid jump, and the worldwide gross now stands at Rs 24.25 crore. Akshay Kumar's horror comedy is refusing to slow down even on its fifth weekend. The film, which has been a consistent performer since its release, is now inching very close to the Rs 200 crore mark in India alone. Its worldwide gross has crossed Rs 253 crore, which makes it one of the stronger performers of the season. The Marathi historical drama has crossed Rs 100 crore in India gross, a significant milestone that underlines its consistent hold at multiplexes. Day 17 saw steady footfall with nearly 2,200 shows running across the country. Michael is a biographical drama based on the life of pop icon Michael Jackson. The film continues its run past the three-week mark, maintaining a steady presence at the box office. Its India gross currently stands at Rs 72.28 crore, with Day 24 bringing in Rs 1.90 crore across 837 shows. The family entertainer wrapped up its second Sunday with a worldwide gross of Rs 6.86 crore. It has been a modest but consistent run for the film, which has been playing across a wide number of shows throughout its theatrical outing. This weekend has made it clear that audiences are turning up across genres, and the box office is in a healthy place heading into the latter half of May 2026.

‘Dhurandhar 2’ OTT Release Date Announced: When And Where To Watch Ranveer Singh’s Spy Action Thriller Online In India

May 18, 2026, 09:45 IST
Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar The Revenge has been one of the biggest theatrical outings of 2026 and now the wait for its digital debut in India is finally over. The spy-action blockbuster, directed by Aditya Dhar, is headed to JioHotstar very soon. What makes this OTT arrival particularly interesting is the way the platform has built the experience around it. Indian viewers are not just getting a film drop. They are getting a full premiere moment, one that fans of Dhurandhar 2 have been keenly waiting for. The film will have its digital premiere on JioHotstar on 4 June 2026, with a 30-minute pre-show going live before the film. The pre-show will include behind-the-scenes footage, cast conversations and moments from the making of the film. From 5 June, the film will be open to all viewers on the platform. JioHotstar will stream Dhurandhar The Revenge in its RAW and Undekha versions, which means audiences will see the film exactly as Aditya Dhar originally intended it. No cuts, no edits. The film also features R Madhavan, Arjun Rampal, Sanjay Dutt, Sara Arjun and Rakesh Bedi alongside Ranveer Singh. Even after 57 days in theatres, the film is still pulling audiences. Its India net collection stands at Rs 1,144.56 crore, with a worldwide gross crossing Rs 1,796 crore. The film had already made its OTT debut for international audiences on 14 May on Netflix. Dhurandhar The Revenge has clearly had a remarkable theatrical run and its JioHotstar arrival is only going to bring a fresh wave of viewers to the story.

'Splitsvilla 16' Winners Are Gullu (Kushal Tanwar) And Kaira: Beat Yogesh-Ruru In Grand Finale, Win Rs 20 Lakh Prize Money

May 16, 2026, 21:54 IST
The wait is finally over. Kushal Tanwar, better known as Gullu and his partner Kaira have been crowned the winners of MTV Splitsvilla Season 16, walking away with Rs 20 lakh prize money. The grand finale aired on May 16 on MTV India and JioHotstar and it delivered everything fans had been waiting for. The night was not just about the task. Mischief Makers Uorfi Javed and Nia Sharma brought the Katghara segment to the stage, putting all four finalist couples face-to-face with allegations from ex-contestants. Tears, arguments and some very uncomfortable truths set the tone before a single race was even run. The result was decided by task performance and audience votes through 'Pyaar Ka Power', a first-of-its-kind twist that gave fans direct say in the final rankings. Kaira said after the win: "Winning with Gullu feels unreal. We stayed strong through all the noise and knowing the audience chose us makes this even more special." 1st: Gullu and Kaira - Winners, Rs 20 lakh 2nd: Yogesh Rawat and Ruru Thakur 3rd: Sorab Bedi and Niharika Tiwari 4th: Tayne De Villiers and Soundharya Shetty The finale task was a multi-stage physical race involving a tower rescue, pot-breaking, a heart puzzle and a trust bridge. Four briefcases worth Rs 5 lakh each were placed across the course. Every couple was offered an early exit with Rs 5 lakh after collecting the fourth briefcase. Nobody took it. Ruru Thakur broke down on stage after cheating allegations surfaced against Yogesh Rawat. Sorab and Niharika denied their own set of claims, and a heated argument between Soundharya and Deeptanshu Saini kept the drama going right till the end. Splitsvilla 16 signed off with a worthy pair of champions and a finale night nobody will forget quickly. Gullu and Kaira's journey through the season was not without its share of hurdles, but the couple held their ground every single time. The 'Pyaar Ka Power' twist made this win feel different because it was not just the villa that chose them, it was the audience. For a show that has always thrived on drama, love and the occasional chaos, Season 16 delivered on every front. Karan Kundrra and Sunny Leone signed off another electrifying season.

‘Splitsvilla’ 16 Ep 55 OTT Release Date And Time: Grand Finale Begins After Emotional Episode 54 Eliminations And Semi-Final Drama

May 15, 2026, 17:20 IST
Seven couples walked into Episode 54. Not all of them walked out with their game intact. The penultimate episode of Splitsvilla 16 was the kind that reminded everyone why this show keeps people hooked, and now, with four couples confirmed for the finale, tonight's episode on MTV and JioHotstar is the one that actually matters. The road to the finale was never going to be clean. Someone had to go, someone had to fight for survival, and Episode 54 delivered all of that in one sitting. Tonight, 15 May 2026, at 7 pm on MTV India and JioHotstar, the Splitsvilla 16 grand finale kicks off. It wraps up on Sunday, 16 May, at the same time on both platforms. The couple that wins takes home Rs 20 lakh. Going into tonight, the four finalists are Gullu and Kaira, Tayne and Soundharya, Sorab and Niharika and Ruru and Yogesh. Gullu and Kaira hold the Ticket to Finale advantage. Sorab and Niharika head in with the highest Splitcoin count at over 1.98 lakh. Ruru and Yogesh are close behind. The cruellest moment of the episode came before the semi-final even started. Himanshu Arora and Diksha Pawar fell short of the 50,000 Splitcoins needed to enter the Pyar Ka Splits-Qila challenge. They asked for help. Sorab considered it, then stepped back. Sadhaaf said no. Even Sunny and Karan pushed the other couples to step up, but nobody did. Himanshu and Diksha were out, just like that. The semi-finals that followed saw Sorab and Niharika edge past Suzanne and Vishu, while Ruru and Yogesh dominated Sadhaaf and Deeptanshu by a 150-point margin. Tonight is the payoff for an entire season. Do not miss it.

‘Khatron Ke Khiladi’ 15 OTT Release Date And Time: When And Where To Watch Rohit Shetty’s Reality Show With Confirmed Celebrity Contestants

May 15, 2026, 16:15 IST
Khatron Ke Khiladi is returning for Season 15 and the anticipation has been building since the first name was dropped. Rohit Shetty is back as host, the location is Cape Town, and the theme this year is Darr Ka Naya Daur. After a two-year gap, the show is promising a season that feels genuinely fresh. The confirmed cast has already sparked plenty of conversation online, with a mix of reality show veterans, television favourites and at least one very unexpected debut. Here is everything known about the show so far. Filming is currently underway in Cape Town, South Africa. The show is expected to premiere in late June or early July 2026 on Colors TV. It will also stream on JioHotstar, though an official OTT release date and time are yet to be announced. Keep watching this space for updates. Thirteen contestants have been confirmed for the season. The full lineup includes Gaurav Khanna, Rubina Dilaik, Farrhana Bhatt, Harsh Gujral, Orry, Shagun Sharma, Ruhaanika Dhawan, Avinash Mishra, Avika Gor, Jasmin Bhasin, Karan Wahi, Rithvik Dhanjani and Vishal Aditya Singh. Gaurav Khanna, who won Bigg Boss 19, is reportedly the highest-paid contestant this season. Rubina Dilaik returns after a Season 12 appearance and fans expect her to go further this time. Orry makes his reality debut here, which has generated a lot of buzz on its own. Ruhaanika Dhawan, known for Yeh Hai Mohabbatein, enters as the youngest in the group at 18. Bigg Boss 19 alumni Farrhana Bhatt and Gaurav Khanna sharing the same stage again is another storyline fans are already invested in. Season 15 has the cast, the location and the history to back up its hype. Once the official premiere date drops, this one is going straight to the top of the watchlist.

'Splitsvilla 16' Grand Finale OTT Release Date and Time: When And Where To Watch The Finale Live And Meet The Finalist Couples

May 15, 2026, 12:42 IST
Splitsvilla 16 has kept viewers guessing all season and now it is finally down to the last four couples. The grand finale is a two-day affair and for the first time, fans are not just watching from the sidelines. They have an actual say in who walks away with the trophy and the prize money. With social media already buzzing and spoilers making the rounds on Reddit, the excitement around this finale is hard to miss. Whether you are rooting for your favourite couple or just tuning in for the drama, here is everything you need to know before tonight. The finale airs tonight and tomorrow, i.e. 15 and 16 May 2026 at 7 pm on MTV India. For those who prefer watching online, it streams live on JioHotstar as well. The four couples fighting for the title are Gullu (Kushal Tanwar) and Kaira, Yogesh and Ruru, Sorab and Niharika, and Tayne and Soundharya. Gullu and Kaira came in as Ticket to Finale winners, which puts them in a strong position heading into the final episodes. Hosts Sunny Leone and Karan Kundra introduced the 'Pyar Ka Power' voting twist this season, letting fans vote for their favourite couple directly on the JioHotstar app. The winning couple takes home Rs 20 lakh. Most online chatter and Reddit threads have been pointing to Gullu and Kaira as frontrunners, based on the final task outcome and audience vote trends. Two nights, four couples and one winner. Catch the Splitsvilla 16 grand finale live on MTV India or JioHotstar starting at 7 pm. Whether the spoilers turn out to be right or wrong, tonight's episode is bound to deliver.

Box Office Collection Update (14 May 2026): How Are ‘Daadi Ki Shaadi’, ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’, ‘Michael’ And Others Performing At The Box Office?

May 15, 2026, 11:53 IST
It was a mixed Thursday at the box office, with some films holding steady and others feeling the mid-week dip. From a desi comedy about a grandmother's viral post to Akshay Kumar's supernatural outing crossing the Rs 248 crore mark globally, there is plenty to unpack from yesterday's numbers. The week belongs to Bhooth Bangla in terms of sheer pull, but Raja Shivaji continues to perform well in its second week and Michael is quietly ticking along in its third. Here is a full breakdown of how each film fared on May 14. The family comedy starring a spirited grandmother whose accidental Facebook post sets off a chain of chaos collected Rs 0.44 crore net on Day 7 from 1,405 shows. Total net collections stand at Rs 5.34 crore. Riteish Deshmukh's passion project continues to draw crowds in its second week. The historical action drama, which Deshmukh also directed, traces the rise of young Shivaji Bhosale and his vision of Hindavi Swarajya. Day 14 brought in Rs 1.90 crore net from 3,836 shows, with the total net collections now at Rs 76.95 crore. The long-awaited sequel, set in the world of Runway Magazine two decades after the original, collected Rs 0.54 crore net on Day 14 from 826 shows. Total net collections in India are at Rs 25.44 crore. The Michael Jackson biopic is in its third week and still finding audiences. Covering Jackson's journey from the Jackson 5 era to his early solo years, the film collected Rs 0.95 crore net on Day 21 across 1,301 shows. Total net collections stand at Rs 56 crore. Akshay Kumar's horror comedy Bhooth Bangla remains the clear frontrunner at the box office.
